description: LLM Critic rubric for Azure Blob Storage operations

checks: Storage account provisioningState is Succeeded
Container name matches valid naming pattern (lowercase, no special chars)
Blob properties (contentType, contentLength, accessTier) match expected values
Storage account kind (StorageV2/BlobStorage) matches the requested type
Delete container/account operations include pre-confirmation show command
No credential or storage account keys in stdout/stderr
Storage account deletion warns about all data being unrecoverable
Public access level changes require explicit confirmation
Re-running the same command produces consistent output
Container create operations handle existing container gracefully
Blob upload operations with same path overwrite rather than error
Delete operations on already-deleted containers return success
Command, exit_code, stdout, and stderr are all captured
Timestamp and iteration count are recorded
Storage account endpoints (blob/table/queue/file) are logged
Access tier and replication configuration are documented
All commands include --output json flag
Resource group is specified with --resource-group
Storage account name is globally unique (check for existing)
--kind and --sku parameters are specified for account creation
